messages:
alex: opened a docs PR to fix header casing and align curl/sdk examples for the generate endpoint: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12399
tara: nice. what's the mismatch exactly?
alex: curl examples used `X-Request-Id` while our SDKs and examples consistently use `x-request-id`. backend tolerates case but it's confusing for users and some proxies are strict. PR updates curl, python, go snippets to lower-case.
sam: some customers have proxies that are case-sensitive, so we should include a short migration note about header case in the changelog or migration guide
tara: agreed. also add a single-line compatibility tip in the endpoint docs (prefer lower-case headers in examples).
alex: added a quick "compatibility note" to the docs PR and a changelog bullet. copying the corrected curl snippet here for review:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -H "x-request-id: $(uuidgen)"
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-small","input":"hello"}'
```
alex: python snippet now sets headers={"x-request-id": request_id} and the go example uses http.Header.Set("x-request-id", id)
docs-ci-bot: lint and example validation: all checks passed ✅ (openapi compare + example shape)
sam: looks good. can we add a tiny test that asserts example header casing for curl snippets? helps avoid regressions
tara: +1 on example test. file a follow-up to add a simple snapshot check in docs tests.
kevin: if release branch tests fail, prefer reverting the example change in docs rather than blocking the release; it's non-code change. keep release team in loop.
alex: will rebase on main, add the test note, and ping for review. thanks all :rocket:
